answerable.question: How long do customers on a monthly plan have to request a full refund?
answerable.ground_truth: Monthly plan customers can request a full refund within 14 days of their first payment.

answerable.question: What is the refund window for annual plans?
answerable.ground_truth: Annual plans can be fully refunded within 30 days of purchase.

answerable.question: When can an annual customer get a prorated refund after 30 days?
answerable.ground_truth: A prorated refund is available only if the account has had a documented service outage of more than 24 hours.

answerable.question: How long does it take for an approved refund to reach the customer?
answerable.ground_truth: Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method within 7 business days.

answerable.question: Can I get a refund for add-on credits I already used?
answerable.ground_truth: No. Refunds are not available for add-on credits that have already been consumed.

answerable.question: How long is the free trial and do I need a credit card?
answerable.ground_truth: The free trial lasts 14 days, includes all Pro features, and requires no credit card.

answerable.question: How do I connect my first data source?
answerable.ground_truth: Open Settings, choose Integrations, and select a connector such as PostgreSQL, BigQuery or Google Sheets.

answerable.question: How many team members can I invite on the Starter plan?
answerable.ground_truth: Up to 5 team members on the Starter plan.

answerable.question: Which workspace role is allowed to manage billing?
answerable.ground_truth: Only Admins can manage billing and delete data sources.

answerable.question: How often do dashboards refresh and can Pro users change it?
answerable.ground_truth: Dashboards refresh every 6 hours by default, and Pro customers can set it as often as every 15 minutes.

answerable.question: What encryption does Acme Analytics use for customer data?
answerable.ground_truth: AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.2 or higher in transit.

answerable.question: Which plan supports SAML single sign-on?
answerable.ground_truth: SAML 2.0 single sign-on is supported on the Pro plan.

answerable.question: Is customer data used to train machine learning models?
answerable.ground_truth: No. Customer data is never used to train machine learning models.

answerable.question: How long until my data is removed from backups after deleting a workspace?
answerable.ground_truth: Data is removed from production within 30 days and from backups within 90 days.

answerable.question: What are the support hours?
answerable.ground_truth: Chat support is available 8am to 8pm Gulf Standard Time, Sunday to Thursday.
